steps.title: Replatform the existing King’s Edge app
steps.summary: Rebuild the existing King’s Edge app on the agreed Azure and shared-application foundations between November 2026 and the end of January 2027. The replacement must achieve verified feature parity before cutover, preserving existing student records, content, operational workflows and service continuity while creating a stronger base for subsequent product development.

outputs.title: Opportunity catalogue and activity pages
outputs.summary: Preserve the existing catalogue and student-facing details for events, self-paced activity and other published opportunities.

outputs.title: Search, filters and curated discovery
outputs.summary: Preserve search, filtering, browsing, recommendations, curated collections and cohort-specific landing experiences.

outputs.title: Saved opportunities and calendar
outputs.summary: Preserve bookmarking or saving opportunities and the student calendar view of planned participation.

outputs.title: Registration and booking management
outputs.summary: Preserve student sign-up, booking status, capacity management, cancellations and associated confirmations.

outputs.title: Attendance and QR check-in
outputs.summary: Preserve attendance recording, including QR-enabled check-in and the operational tools used to manage attendance.

outputs.title: Self-paced and self-study activity
outputs.summary: Preserve access to on-demand and self-study opportunities and the associated participation and completion records.

outputs.title: Cohort restrictions and targeted curation
outputs.summary: Preserve staff controls for restricting, inviting and curating activity for defined student cohorts.

outputs.title: Independent activity and K-Points claims
outputs.summary: Preserve student claims for eligible independent activity, evidence upload, verification and the associated K-Points record.

outputs.title: Student dashboard and participation history
outputs.summary: Preserve the student view of bookings, attendance, completed activity, claims, K-Points and recognition status.

outputs.title: Notifications and participant communications
outputs.summary: Preserve service notifications and the communications used to support bookings, attendance and participation.

outputs.title: Staff activity and participant administration
outputs.summary: Preserve staff tools for creating and publishing activity, managing content and providers, administering participants and recording outcomes.

outputs.title: Reporting, analytics and audit
outputs.summary: Preserve operational reporting, engagement data, exports and audit trails required to run and evaluate the service.

outputs.title: Data, content and history migration
outputs.summary: Migrate the required live and historical records, validate parity and complete a controlled cutover without loss of service.

steps.title: Digital Badge Management Infrastructure
steps.summary: Deliver the in-house infrastructure for managing digital badges between February and May 2027, including the migration and cutover required to replace Accredible. This epic provides the technical service and operational continuity; the future King’s Edge badge portfolio remains owned through the recognition proposition led by 2.4.3.

outputs.title: Badge definitions and metadata
outputs.summary: Create and manage badge metadata, criteria, evidence requirements, validity and presentation.

outputs.title: Issuer and administrator management
outputs.summary: Provide roles, permissions and workflows for authorised issuers and central administrators.

outputs.title: Issuance management
outputs.summary: Support automatic, staff-awarded and approved claim-based issuance through one governed service.

outputs.title: Student badge record
outputs.summary: Provide a student-facing record of earned credentials and their supporting criteria or evidence.

outputs.title: Public verification
outputs.summary: Provide secure public verification of valid credentials and their current status.

outputs.title: Revocation, correction and audit
outputs.summary: Provide controls and records for correcting, revoking, auditing and reporting badge activity.

outputs.title: Accredible migration and cutover
outputs.summary: Migrate or preserve the required issuers, badge definitions and credential records and validate continuity before the existing service is stood down.

outputs.title: Supported production service
outputs.summary: Complete accessibility, security, monitoring, documentation, support and named service-ownership arrangements.

steps.title: King’s Canvas prototype
steps.summary: Develop and test a bounded working prototype of King’s Canvas between February and May 2027, in parallel with the digital badge management infrastructure. The prototype should help students articulate needs and aspirations, form a revisitable plan and move towards relevant opportunities without committing prematurely to a full production service.

outputs.title: Visual planning interface
outputs.summary: Allow students to explore and organise needs, aspirations, priorities and intended next steps.

outputs.title: Saved and revisitable plan
outputs.summary: Create a persistent personal plan that students can return to and update over time.

outputs.title: Structured planning prompts
outputs.summary: Guide students from broad aspirations towards clearer priorities and practical actions.

outputs.title: Bounded AI coaching
outputs.summary: Use constrained AI-supported dialogue to help students articulate options without presenting authoritative advice.

outputs.title: Prototype opportunity links
outputs.summary: Connect Canvas content to relevant parts of the live opportunity catalogue through controlled rules and curated routes.

outputs.title: Closed student testing
outputs.summary: Test usefulness, accessibility, trust and interaction with a limited student cohort.

outputs.title: Prototype evaluation and next-stage decision
outputs.summary: Produce evidence, design changes, assurance requirements and a clear scope for subsequent beta development.

steps.title: Projects, experiences and curated pathways
steps.summary: Extend King’s Edge between May and August 2027 into projects, sustained experiences, self-paced participation and curated developmental routes, using the replatformed app and common activity model.

outputs.title: Project and sustained-experience spaces
outputs.summary: Provide structured spaces for longer activities with defined participants, purpose, responsibilities and completion requirements.

outputs.title: Milestones and progress tracking
outputs.summary: Support progress states, milestones and completion tracking for activity that unfolds over time.

outputs.title: Resources, groups and communications
outputs.summary: Support activity delivery through resource hosting, participant groups and communications.

outputs.title: Submissions, outputs and showcases
outputs.summary: Allow participants to submit work, record outputs and make selected achievements visible.

outputs.title: Self-paced and on-demand participation
outputs.summary: Support activity without a fixed event date within the common activity model.

outputs.title: Collections and progression pathways
outputs.summary: Create curated routes through coherent sets of opportunities from lighter-touch to deeper experiences.

outputs.title: Provider-curated spaces
outputs.summary: Allow faculties, services and approved providers to organise and present their offer through managed spaces.

steps.title: King’s Canvas beta and opportunity matching
steps.summary: Develop the prototype into a controlled beta during September and October 2027. Test how students move from their plans into relevant opportunities, how Canvas remains useful over time and how aggregated needs can inform curation and commissioning.

outputs.title: Controlled King’s Canvas beta
outputs.summary: Release a more robust version to a wider but bounded student cohort.

outputs.title: Plan-to-opportunity matching
outputs.summary: Test rules and curated recommendations that connect plans to relevant live opportunities.

outputs.title: Progress and next-step prompts
outputs.summary: Help students revisit and update their plans and identify practical next steps.

outputs.title: Connections to projects and pathways
outputs.summary: Connect Canvas priorities to projects, sustained experiences and curated pathways.

outputs.title: Needs and provision insight
outputs.summary: Generate privacy-aware insight into recurring student needs and potential gaps in the opportunity offer.

steps.title: Integrated King’s Edge release
steps.summary: Bring the replatformed app, project and experience capabilities, King’s Canvas beta, evidence and digital badge management infrastructure together during November and December 2027 as one coherent and supportable King’s Edge release.

outputs.title: Coherent student experience
outputs.summary: Provide joined-up journeys across discovery, participation, projects, Canvas, evidence and badge records.

outputs.title: Integrated data and records
outputs.summary: Maintain continuity across activity, planning, evidence and recognition records.

outputs.title: Production assurance
outputs.summary: Complete accessibility, security, privacy, performance and operational-readiness assurance.

outputs.title: Live product analytics
outputs.summary: Provide evidence on student and provider use of the service.

outputs.title: Transition and adoption
outputs.summary: Support students, providers and operational teams through the integrated release.

steps.title: Product operations and service stabilisation
steps.summary: Use January to June 2028 to stabilise the integrated service and establish routine product, support and operational practices.

outputs.title: Priority live-service fixes
outputs.summary: Resolve the most important defects, usability issues and operational gaps.

outputs.title: Product and service ownership
outputs.summary: Confirm decision rights and responsibilities for the roadmap and live service.

outputs.title: Support and release operations
outputs.summary: Embed incident, release, maintenance, monitoring and recovery arrangements.

outputs.title: Routine product cadence
outputs.summary: Establish a repeatable discovery, prioritisation, release and evaluation cycle.

outputs.title: Adoption and provider support
outputs.summary: Provide targeted support for effective use of the new capabilities.

steps.title: Personalised planning, progression and reflection
steps.summary: Use live evidence during July to December 2028 to strengthen movement from planning into activity, from lighter-touch to deeper experiences, and from completion into reflection, evidence and recognition.

outputs.title: Improved opportunity matching
outputs.summary: Strengthen connections from Canvas priorities into relevant opportunities and next steps.

outputs.title: Progression pathways
outputs.summary: Support movement from introductory activity into deeper experiences.

outputs.title: Evidence and recognition connections
outputs.summary: Connect completion to verified evidence and the recognition routes led through 2.4.3.

outputs.title: Post-activity reflection
outputs.summary: Prompt students to articulate learning and decide what comes next.

outputs.title: Offer insight and curation
outputs.summary: Use participation and Canvas evidence to improve provision.

steps.title: King’s Edge in the shared student app
steps.summary: Move King’s Edge into the shared student-app environment during January to June 2029 while retaining ownership of the Edge proposition, content, curation and developmental journeys.

outputs.title: Shared home and navigation
outputs.summary: Make Edge available through common student-app entry points.

outputs.title: Shared profile, search and communications
outputs.summary: Reuse common capabilities where they meet the Edge need.

outputs.title: Continuity of records and journeys
outputs.summary: Preserve activity, evidence, recognition and planning records through the transition.

outputs.title: Retirement of duplicated functions
outputs.summary: Replace Edge-specific functions where common services are ready and supportable.

outputs.title: Focused Edge roadmap
outputs.summary: Continue selective development of Canvas, opportunities, projects and evidence.

steps.title: Mature King’s Edge product domain
steps.summary: Complete the transition during July to December 2029 into a stable product domain within the Student Experience Hub, with enduring ownership and continuous improvement.

outputs.title: Stable shared product domain
outputs.summary: Operate Edge through shared app, data, integration and service capabilities.

outputs.title: Enduring ownership
outputs.summary: Confirm clear product, service and operational accountability.

outputs.title: Analytics and continuous improvement
outputs.summary: Embed routine monitoring and prioritisation of improvements.

outputs.title: Controlled rationalisation
outputs.summary: Retire redundant components where continuity is assured.
